{{Quote|You will contact an undercover agent already working here in Doaba Guerfel. She will have your best leads on finding someone in the Chirq Council.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
'''Lilith Laughlin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] small-time thug who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Rumor has reached my ears of a CorSec agent masquerading as a small-time thug in order to gather information about the Council.|[[Jzoro Quanera]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lilith Laughlin was a small-time thug who resided in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] and served as an undercover agent for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Corellian Security Force started an investigation against the [[Chirq Council]], also known by the CorSec as the Red Circle Gang, following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia. After it was discovered that the criminal organization was based in Doaba Guerfel,<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] was designated to lead the investigation.<ref name="SWG:SwCB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Speak with Captain Baize|Corellia}}</ref> Captain Baize decided to use the help of Lilith Laughlin to discover putative Chirq Council members in Doaba Guerfel. However, Laughlin was not able to help the CorSec at that moment because some [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] cudgels led by [[Ventil Tamplin]] and [[Lilea Norith]] harassed her because they suspected her true allegiance. Captain Baize thus dispatched a spacer who previously worked for CorSec to deal definitively with the Ragtags.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

Lilith Laughlin immediately started to work for Captain Baize, and she quickly found possible connections between the Red Circle Gang and a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] terrorist organization known as the [[Drall Patriots]]. However, after a search in the [[Drall Patriot Warehouse]] in Doaba Guerfel, it appeared that there was no connection between the two groups. Laughlin later sent the spacer to talk with [[Gwhirrye Baric]], a thug who ran a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] racket out of a small hospital in Doaba Guerfel. After the spacer helped him to deal with [[Xyrias Undea]] and the [[Rogue CorSec]] miscreants who harassed his business, Baric agreed to reveal a name: [[Trins Evnar]]. The man was a spice dealer with a red circle tattoo on his arm.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> Thanks to this information, Captain Baize discovered the identity of several Chirq Council members and embedded an agent within the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCAI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Assumed Identity|Corellia}}</ref>

The Chirq Council later discovered that an informant helped the CorSec in its investigation. The underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] thus tasked Captain Baize's infiltrated agent to find and kill the informant. In order to protect Lilith Laughlin, the agent instead killed another woman, [[Ebela Puckett]], a [[Grey Shroud terrorists|Grey Shroud terrorist]], and Captain Baize created evidence that the terrorist was working for CorSec. Having earned the trust of Jzoro Quaner, the agent was given full access to Quanera's database and obtained the identity of the nine [[Elite Council|elite councilors]] who ruled the Chirq Council and the locations of their [[First Elite Council Bunker|secret]] [[Second Elite Council Bunker|headquarters]].<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" /> The CorSec operation eventually destroyed the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lilith Laughlin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lilith Laughlin was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
